Adjust the actor's default portrait directly from the Portrait tab. Fixed portrait field alignment and character-name wrapping. Settings retain scroll positions when editing variants or returning to an actor or tab.

announcement.title: ⚔️ Stylish Action HUD v3.1.4
announcement.content:
v3.1.4 Update

  • Adjust the default portrait's scale and position without adding a variant. Removing the last variant returns to the default image.
  • Portrait variant fields stay aligned in narrow settings windows.
  • Character names above the Action Menu wrap between words, with more room in Epic Fantasy and Glass.
  • Settings retain scroll positions when adding or removing variants and when returning to an actor or tab.
